items.title: Alton Purnell Interview, 1958-08-29
items.q: We used to call him Boogie Woogie. He was a cripple fellow. And he used to play some, but that's before Boogie Woogie, I never heard any other thing about Boogie Woogie then

ctx.x: You say he made piano rolls? Yeah. I didn't know that.

Yeah. That's what they told me, that he used to make piano rolls. And we used to sit on the crib and the sidewalk and look in the ballroom, you know, they had these little doors that cut from the top and bottom. And I used to listen to these piano players. Then they had a place on the wagon top where they had a wonderful Boogie Woogie piano player. We used to call him Boogie Woogie. He was a cripple fellow. And he used to play some, but that's before Boogie Woogie, I never heard any other thing about Boogie…
Where was it that you finally evened up the sky?
